_readme: Single source of truth for the checkable public claims. The pricing cards in src/pages/index.astro are RENDERED from `plans.*.bullets`; scripts/verify-claims.mjs checks every `verify` rule against the app's GET /api/v1/_meta/plans (ENTITLEMENTS). `{value}` in text is filled from the first `limit` rule, so a number lives in exactly one place. `static` = cannot be checked against entitlements (listed as UNVERIFIED in the verifier output). Prices are NOT here: they live in Stripe/App Store Connect and are guarded by review. See the app repo's docs/PUBLIC_CLAIMS.md.
